text:
Maria G.: Heads up — Helix Analytics' private deployment renewal (term ends 2024-04-01) landed in my inbox and the platform fee on the pro forma is 20% higher than the agreed rate.
Anne T.: Can you paste the invoice lines? If it's the platform fee line we might have applied the new 2024 priceband by mistake.
Maria G.: Copy/paste of relevant lines:
```
PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY: $48,000  # billed as 4 nodes x $12k
SUPPORT_TIER: PremiumPlus: $9,000
DEDICATED_COMMIT: 3xA100 reserved -> billed 3
```
Jason L.: FYI, Helix upgraded from Standard->PremiumPlus mid-term (2024-01-15). We agreed to prorate support tier, not full month back-date.
Anne T.: Yep. Our billing rule is "prorate to change date" for support. Looks like the pro forma used full-month charge.
Vikram S.: Also saw a true-up item: committed GPU hours show 2,400 vs committed 1,800 — that's a 600-hour true-up. Is that expected from their usage spike?
Priya (AcctMgr): They had a burst in Feb for model testing. Jason — did we authorize temporary burst without changing commit level?
Jason L.: We authorized temporary burst under the burst-cap policy, but that should be billed as usage overage, not reclassifying the commit.
Maria G.: So action items: 1) Re-generate pro forma with corrected prorated support line and separate usage true-up line; 2) Remove accidental 4-node platform fee if they only have 3 nodes committed; 3) Hold invoice send until we confirm with Jason.
billing-bot: Invoice draft 2024-03-06T14:12 created (id: inv-draft-7821). Status: DRAFT.
Anne T.: I'll update the draft and attach notes explaining the prorate calculation. Estimated delta: -$12,000 platform fee + prorated support adj (~ -$4,500) + true-up usage +$18,000 -> net +$1,500. Will confirm math.
Vikram S.: For the true-up, please include breakdown: hours, nodes, region (us-west-2), instance types (A100-80GB). Ops will provide the kerning logs if accounting needs verification.
Priya (AcctMgr): Can we offer to delay payment 7 days while we reissue? Customer asked for a soft extension to their renewal date.
Maria G.: We can offer a 7-day hold but we need an approved credit/extension. Jason — can sales OK a 7-day extension without discount?
Jason L.: OK to approve 7-day hold. No discounts. I'll confirm with Helix and ask them to sign an acknowledgement email.
Anne T.: I'll mark draft as "on-hold" and set due date +7 after we resend. tagging @billing-bot to add note.
billing-bot: Invoice inv-draft-7821 updated: status -> ON_HOLD, note added: "Awaiting sales confirmation email and final pro forma." (automated)
Maria G.: Thanks team. If Anne posts the updated pro forma here I'll review before final send. Goal: send corrected invoice by EOD tomorrow.
Jason L.: I'll loop in legal if they push on the retroactive platform fee. Expect follow-up.
Priya (AcctMgr): Noted. Will prep the customer-facing summary once final numbers are locked.
Anne T.: Uploaded updated pro forma to the thread: https://redwood-internal/docs/invoices/helix-proforma-7821.pdf :thumbsup: 
Maria G.: Reviewed and approved. Anne — go ahead to finalize and send when Helix confirms.
